features.description: Total Smart DID requests for the book
features.computation: COALESCE(be.request_count, 0)

features.description: Relevance ranking score from Smart DID (0-1 or 0-100)
features.computation: CASE WHEN COALESCE(be.ranking_score, 0) > 1 THEN LEAST(be.ranking_score / 100.0, 1.0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(be.ranking_score, 0), 0) END

features.description: Request count with 30-day exponential decay half-life
features.computation: LN(1 + COALESCE(be.request_count, 0)) * EXP(-LN(2.0) / 30.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - COALESCE(be.last_requested_at, be.created_at, NOW()))) / 86400.0)

features.description: Composite priority score from all signals (40% decayed request, 30% ranking, 15% retry, 10% expiry, 5% starvation)
features.computation: 40 * decayed_request_signal + 30 * normalized_ranking_score + 15 * retry_signal + 10 * expiry_signal + 5 * starvation_signal

features.description: Hours since priority score was last refreshed (null = never scored)
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - be.score_last_refreshed_at)) / 3600.0

features.description: Sum of request counts from engagement snapshots in the last 7 days
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.request_count), 0) FROM book_engagement_snapshots s WHERE s.book_id = be.book_id AND s.captured_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

features.description: Sum of request counts from engagement snapshots in the last 30 days
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.request_count), 0) FROM book_engagement_snapshots s WHERE s.book_id = be.book_id AND s.captured_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

features.description: Average ranking score from engagement snapshots in the last 30 days
features.computation: SELECT AVG(s.ranking_score) FROM book_engagement_snapshots s WHERE s.book_id = be.book_id AND s.captured_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

features.description: Number of engagement snapshots captured in the last 90 days (activity frequency)
features.computation: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_engagement_snapshots s WHERE s.book_id = be.book_id AND s.captured_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

features.description: Hours since the most recent engagement snapshot
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT MAX(s.captured_at) FROM book_engagement_snapshots s WHERE s.book_id = be.book_id))) / 3600.0

features.description: Current video status from Smart DID
Number of video state retry attempts
features.computation: COALESCE(svs.retry_count, 0)

features.description: Whether the video has a non-null error message
features.computation: svs.error_message IS NOT NULL

features.description: Hours until video URL expires (negative = already expired)
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (svs.expires_at - NOW())) / 3600.0

features.description: Curated age segment for recommendations
Display priority/order for recommendations
Video scenario type (e.g. mood-based, educational, storytelling)
Scenario processing state (pending/processing/completed/failed/skipped)
Scenario priority order (higher = more urgent)
features.computation: COALESCE(bvs.priority, 0)

features.description: Whether the scenario has a non-null error message
features.computation: bvs.error_message IS NOT NULL

features.description: Total number of scenarios for this book
features.computation: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_video_scenarios bvs WHERE bvs.book_id = be.book_id

features.description: Current video job scheduling priority (0-100 range)
features.computation: COALESCE(vj.priority_score, 0)

features.description: Number of DID request retries for the video job
features.computation: COALESCE(vj.did_request_retries, 0)

features.description: Hours until video job expires (negative = already expired)
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (vj.expires_at - NOW())) / 3600.0

features.description: Current status of the video job
Status reported by Smart DID for the video job
Number of times the video job has been retried
features.computation: COALESCE(vj.retry_count, 0)

features.description: Days since job was created (starvation signal — old pending jobs get boost)
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - vj.created_at)) / 86400.0

features.description: Audience consensus agreement score (0-1) for video labels
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(av.agreement_score), 0) FROM audience_validation av WHERE av.video_id IN (SELECT vj.id FROM video_jobs vj WHERE vj.book_id = be.book_id)

features.description: Number of validators who contributed to agreement score
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(av.validator_count), 0) FROM audience_validation av WHERE av.video_id IN (SELECT vj.id FROM video_jobs vj WHERE vj.book_id = be.book_id)

features.description: Ratio of successful syncs to total syncs in the last 7 days
features.computation: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dsl.status = 'success')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END FROM did_sync_log dsl WHERE dsl.book_id = be.book_id AND dsl.synced_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

features.description: Total records synced in the last 30 days
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dsl.record_count), 0) FROM did_sync_log dsl WHERE dsl.book_id = be.book_id AND dsl.synced_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

features.description: Count of failed syncs in the last 7 days
features.computation: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM did_sync_log dsl WHERE dsl.book_id = be.book_id AND dsl.status = 'failed' AND dsl.synced_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

features.description: Ratio of webhook-triggered syncs to total syncs (measure of event freshness)
features.computation: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dsl.source = 'webhook')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END FROM did_sync_log dsl WHERE dsl.book_id = be.book_id AND dsl.synced_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

features.description: Hours since the last successful sync (freshness signal)
features.computation: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - bsf.last_synced_at)) / 3600.0

features.description: Whether payload hash changed since last sync (data drift indicator)
features.computation: (bsf.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM LAG(bsf.payload_hash) OVER (PARTITION BY bsf.book_id ORDER BY bsf.last_synced_at))

features.description: Total per-user engagement count (views, likes, shares) across all users
features.computation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be2.engagement_count), 0) FROM book_engagement be2 WHERE be2.book_id = be.book_id

features.description: Number of distinct users who engaged with the book
features.computation: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT be2.user_id) FROM book_engagement be2 WHERE be2.book_id = be.book_id
